title: Will never get tired of this show tbh- was so excited to be invited t...
transcript: I recently went back to just in time to check out the new cast, including Ariana Madix from Vanderpump Rules, who just joined the show as Connie Francis. Now, I had seen some of this cast before back in April when I was at Jeremy Jordan and Carrie St Louis's first performance, so it was really cool to see how they've grown into these roles. Jeremy in particular now feels so natural in this role. I think this is maybe the best he's ever been in any show, and I think the number one reason to go see Just in time right now is for his performance. Carrie St Louis, as well manages to take this relatively small role and make it feel so much more substantial. To be completely honest, I've now seen the show five times, and the role of Sandra Dee Has never particularly stood out to me until I saw Carrie do it. In addition to Jeremy, she is really the other standout in this show for me. But of course, we have to talk about Ariana Madix. Now, I had not seen her perform before, so I really had no clue what to expect. These reality TV Castings can be pretty hit or miss, but I actually was pretty pleasantly surprised. She has a really lovely voice, and while it's definitely different from the Gracie Lawrence sound that I think a lot of us are familiar with from the cast recording it Does, I think, serve this genre of music. And I actually found her who's sorry now? To be quite haunting. I also thought she was really funny and nailed the comedy of the role. So if you are an Ariana Madix fan, I don't think you'll be disappointed. Although you should know that her role is pretty small and she basically peaces out after 45 minutes and doesn't come back until the very end. But I continue to have the best time at this show. I think it is one of the best bio jukebox musicals out there thanks to its really inventive staging by Alex Timbers. The entire theatre feels like you are in a nightclub and it is just a party from start to finish. And with each new performer coming in and putting their own spin on these roles, it is the perfect show to revisit time and time again.
classificationReason: Creator explicitly attended the show ('I recently went back to just in time'), shares detailed first-hand opinions on multiple cast members (Jeremy Jordan, Carrie St. Louis, Ariana Madix) across multiple viewings, constituting a clear first-hand production review.
